purpose: Fleet-wide operational signal quality and normalization provenance over the server-owned bounded scoring window.
primaryGoal: Identify low-quality fields and distinguish measured normalization coverage from unknown evidence without altering source measurements.

dataSources.behavior: Flat snapshot, not an envelope; AbortSignal forwarded; key ['admin','observability','data-quality']; STANDARD stale time 60000 ms, SLOW polling 60000 ms, no background polling, retry 1. No parameters or mutations.
dataSources.units: Counts, dimensionless ratios/percentages, SI seconds, timestamps and normalization identifiers. No physical measurement conversion or wire/cache rewrite.
dataSources.unsupported: Handler lines 32-40 returns 503 when scorer missing or ErrNotConfigured. Other errors return 500; actual deployed behavior unverified.
dataSources.workspace: Server-owned fleet-wide window: no local/global date or vehicle filtering. workspaceScope.ts:22-75 does not enable range; /admin prefix disables vehicle at line 94. Preserve this, do not add selectors.
dataSources.unrenderedPayload: firmware_assignment and firmware_segments exist in scorer.go:96-97 and typed response but are not consumed by this mounted page. This is current source inventory, not permission to invent a new feature or delete wire fields.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Mounted version/table implementations coexist with same-named older data-quality components. Both duplicate section state branches; older components were inspected only for overlap, not audited as another page.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep one mounted presentation owner and shared derivation helpers; reconcile actual callers before consolidating. Do not revive older GlassPanel rendering.

strengths: Version rows use min-w-0, flex-wrap and break-words at lines 29-32.
PageLayout preserves full allocated width; all three sections remain mounted.

issues.rule: MDC-023 / MDC-043 / no mobile data loss
issues.detail: mobileColumns allows field, severity and freshness only. Gap, duplicates, attested/unattested counts and coverage/trust are hidden below md by DataTable.tsx:724-725. This caller supplies no expansion or mobile detail renderer, so those five columns have no source-visible alternate mobile access.
issues.fix: Use existing DataTable expansion/mobile detail capability or a fully scrollable table with all columns. Preserve all five omitted measurements, filters, stable field keys and persistence ID; validate narrow widths and keyboard expansion.

accessibility.status: runtime keyboard, screen reader, contrast, forced colors and touch targets unverified
strengths: Version state has text badges, not color alone.
MetricBar preserves label and unknown ARIA value semantics.
LayoutCard labels itself with its title and exposes full descriptions through a focusable tooltip control.

issues.detail: Caller supplies no caption or name identifying this table. DataTable has a caption contract at lines 290-293; surrounding LayoutCard title association does not automatically name the nested table.
issues.fix: Pass a localized caption using the existing DataTable API and validate table naming, filter focus and mobile detail reachability in the actual DOM.

accessibility.motion: FadeIn wrappers at page lines 87,104,115; MetricBar checks useMotionPreference at lines 51,89-91. FadeIn implementation and actual OS/low-bandwidth motion behavior not exercised.

states.initialLoading: All three sections mounted; loading only with no retained snapshot (page:97,107,118). Version and fields render 180/240px skeletons; OperationalBrief receives loading.
states.empty: Version/field independent explanatory empty states and Refresh actions (version:21-24, field:58-60). Six summary metrics retain no-measurement vs measured zero semantics through normalizationMetrics.
states.unsupported: Initial fatal 503 renders unsupported notice and suppresses raw section errors (page:50-55,74-84). Summary retains Source unavailable text rather than fabricated success.
states.fatalFailure: Non-503 fatal error forwarded to all three section QueryError branches; one refetch callback, page:56-58.
states.refreshFailure: deriveDataState keeps payload and only fatalError reaches section replacement (page:49-55). Refresh failure produces stale and retained notice; source notice remains shell-owned.
states.offline: deriveDataState distinguishes paused refresh with retained data (dataState.ts:169-177); actual shell notice and recovery not exercised.
states.unknown: Null/unknown coverage never becomes zero: helpers.ts:50-53, normalizationMetrics.ts:16-18. Null version remains distinct from explicit v0.

issues.detail: sourceBriefStatus is called with isRefreshing:false even when page passes retained:true due to source.isRefreshing at page:95. On a healthy refresh, brief shows Source loaded plus retained text instead of Refreshing source. PageContainer separately receives the actual query, so this is a local summary inconsistency, not a claim that all freshness is lost.
issues.fix: Forward actual source.isRefreshing through a typed prop to the existing sourceBriefStatus helper; preserve stale/error distinction and retained payload.

visualIssues.detail: MetricBar uses fixed #34d399/#fbbf24 colors rather than the application's semantic/theme source. Saturation and composed contrast are not measured.
visualIssues.fix: Supply existing semantic success/warning CSS colors to MetricBar's solid fill; retain attested labels, all buckets and user theme choices. No new palette or shared MetricBar API needed.

visualIssues.detail: Unattested count uses fixed text-amber-300 despite semantic warning context; this overrides cross-theme role typography rather than deriving emphasis from canonical warning tokens.
visualIssues.fix: Use current semantic warning text treatment and keep the numeric count plus trust badge. Measure real light/dark/high-contrast backgrounds; do not force white or infer contrast from a token name.

architectureIssues.detail: DataTable is nested in LayoutCard without variant='embedded'; DataTable defaults to standalone at line 452, adding its frame inside the card. This is source-confirmed redundant surface ownership; visual impact not exercised.
architectureIssues.fix: Use the existing embedded variant where it preserves controls/scroll behavior; no new table wrapper or surface primitive.

priority.reason: Resolve mobile access to provenance and quality columns before cosmetic changes; then clarify refresh state, table naming and existing semantic palette adoption.

competingImplementations.name: Data-quality presentation twins
competingImplementations.evidence: Page import lines 33-37 resolves continuation-admin-2 barrel. Older versions independently render GlassPanel/table at inspected lines 42-52 and 178-210.
competingImplementations.decision: Do not treat older components as mounted coverage. Keep data-quality/helpers.ts and coverageKpis.tsx as existing derivation dependencies. Other callers/deletion safety remain unverified.

actions: Shared refetch retry in all three sections
Refresh in version and field empty states
DataTable value filters and stable field identity
Inherited table persistence and shell query freshness
dataBehavior: Keep every row/version bucket, legacy/null versus version zero, required-version comparison and sorting.
Keep coverage unknown distinct from measured 0%, counts unknown before snapshot, critical fields derived from raw severity.
Keep raw seconds, percentages, counts and normalization IDs in wire/cache; format only for display.
Keep server scoring-window bounds and explicit inclusive-end explanation; never claim a half-open attested period.
Keep independent mounted sections, flat response, query key/cancellation/polling/retry behavior and retained-data handling.
Keep fleet-wide admin scope without duplicate date/vehicle controls.
Keep all typed wire metadata even when currently unrendered; no fake data or new backend capability.
